query: How do I count objects in groups?

goal.title: Sort coins, thread spools, and pins into counted groups
goal.description: Opens a wallet and empties its coins onto the table, then empties a plastic bag of craft supplies (small thread spools and sewing pins) next to them. Separates the pins, spools, and coins into their own piles, then repeatedly regroups each pile into smaller clusters, counting each cluster and writing the tally on a notepad with a pencil. The process is repeated for every object category to demonstrate counting objects in groups.
goal.final_state: Coins, thread spools, and pins are organized into small counted clusters on the table and the counts are hand-written in tally form on the notepad; the pencil is still in hand when the fine-track annotation ends, about 19 seconds before the video itself ends.
procedure: Open the wallet and empty coins onto the table.
Empty the bag of thread spools and sewing pins beside the coins.
Sort the mixed objects into piles by type.
Move the objects into counted groups and write counts on the notepad.

phases.description: Empty the wallet and plastic bag of materials onto the table.
Separate the coins, spools, and pins into piles.
Group the objects into small clusters, count each cluster, and tally the results on the notepad, repeating for every category.
